meta.review_notes: Privacy policy is extremely outdated (last updated October 2020). Key concerns: extensive data sharing with advertising networks, social media platforms, and analytics providers; comprehensive device fingerprinting including hardware/software info; behavioral tracking for personalization and ads; no explicit policy change notification mechanism. Key positives: PCI DSS certified for payment security; reasonable security arrangements described; users can opt out of marketing and request data updates; dedicated grievance officer and DPO.

app.name: BookMyShow | Movies & Events
app.description: India's largest online ticketing platform for movies, events, plays, sports, and activities.

verdict.one_liner: BookMyShow makes booking tickets easy, but it tracks your behavior extensively and shares your data with advertising networks and social media platforms.
verdict.summary: BookMyShow is India's leading entertainment ticketing platform. It collects personal information including name, contact details, and financial data for transactions. The app also automatically collects comprehensive device and usage data including browser type, IP address, device ID, operating system, cookies, and detailed behavior logs. This data is shared with advertising networks, social media platforms, search engines, analytics providers, payment processors, and event organizers. The platform is PCI DSS certified for payment security and provides opt-out options for marketing. However, the privacy policy has not been updated since October 2020, raising concerns about whether current practices are accurately reflected.
verdict.recommendation_reason: While BookMyShow is convenient for booking tickets, its privacy policy is severely outdated (2020) and it shares your data broadly with advertisers and social media platforms. Consider the privacy trade-off before creating an account.

red.title: Privacy policy has not been updated since October 2020
red.plain_english: BookMyShow's privacy policy was last updated in October 2020 — nearly 6 years ago. This means it may not accurately reflect how your data is currently being used.

red.title: Your data is shared with advertising networks and social media platforms
red.plain_english: BookMyShow shares your personal data with advertising networks and social media platforms so they can show you targeted ads. They also share with search engines and analytics providers.

red.title: App extensively tracks what you view, click, and search for
red.plain_english: BookMyShow logs every page you view, how long you spend, what you search for, what you click on, and the services you use. This information is used to profile you and personalize content.

red.title: App collects detailed device and hardware information
red.plain_english: BookMyShow collects your browser type, IP address, operating system, device ID, cookies, hardware information, software information, and demographic data to build a profile of your device.

red.title: Users under 18 are technically not allowed but no verification exists
red.plain_english: BookMyShow says you must be over 18 to use the service, but there is no age verification system. By using the app, you automatically agree that your legal guardian has consented.

green.title: Payment data is protected by PCI DSS certification
green.plain_english: BookMyShow is PCI DSS certified, which means your payment data is secured according to globally accepted data security standards.

green.title: You can opt out of marketing emails at any time
green.plain_english: You can unsubscribe from marketing and promotional materials using the unsubscribe function in emails or by contacting customer support.

green.title: You can request updates to your personal data
green.plain_english: You can contact BookMyShow to update your personal information, and they will try to process your request.

green.title: Dedicated customer grievance and data protection officer
green.plain_english: BookMyShow has a dedicated Customer Grievance Officer who also serves as the Data Protection Officer for GDPR purposes.
